changed_files.note: Removed the stale 'SUP-002, human voice only' performer wording. reason now cites SUP-002 as amended by BIB-0027: a photoreal CGI frog-bodied figure in livery (anatomy pending_H2, owned by 04-creatures/creature and 03-characters/appearance) who speaks fully articulate English lip-synced to naturalistic frog-mouth movement, with species vocalisation limited to a light tic under normal dialogue. The fields that go into the TTS prompt (gender, timbre, pitch, accent) and the other fields (speed, emotion_range, evidence, IDs) are unchanged. The key order is preserved; nested objects were re-indented only.

rationale_no_design_change: BIB-0027 changes how the character is rendered, not how he speaks. SUP-002 sound_signature still requires fully articulate speech. The existing flat, croaky, low-baritone timbre was already frog-coded, so it fits the CGI frog body. gender stays 'male' and matches appearance.json.

existing_voice_sample.note: The p3-voice-cast sample stays valid because none of the acoustic fields used to synthesise it changed. No audio was regenerated. The voice_json_version stamp in casting.json can be left as is, or 09-audio/voice-generation can re-stamp it as a metadata-only change.

pending_H2: Frog-Footman anatomy (how far it is humanised) is owned by 04-creatures/creature and 03-characters/appearance. If H2 ever picks a very small, fully naturalistic frog, only a pitch review would be needed. No change is proposed now.
